usage.callShape: POST https://agentcash.honcho.dev/api/honcho/search with JSON body {query, limit?, session?, peer?} and a SIWX wallet identity signature
usage.outputShape: body.messages[] (each {id, content, peer_id, session_id, created_at, token_count}); empty array when no matching memory exists
quirks: authMode=siwx: requires a SIWX wallet identity signature, NOT a USDC payment. The unpaid probe returns 402/payable, but with a valid SIWX identity it settles FREE (200, $0).
Returns {messages:[]} (empty array) for a fresh wallet identity that has no stored agent memory — this is a correct success, not an error.
Search is scoped to the calling wallet's identity (its stored peer/session memory); results are per-identity.
Only 'query' is required. Optional: limit (default 10, max 100), session, peer to narrow scope.
usage.guide: Call POST https://agentcash.honcho.dev/api/honcho/search with a JSON body containing at least {"query":"..."} and a SIWX wallet identity (sign-in), not a payment — the endpoint is free once authenticated. Optionally add limit (1-100), session, or peer to narrow the search. Read results from body.messages[], where each item has content, peer_id, session_id, created_at and token_count. An empty messages array means no stored memory matched for that wallet identity (expected for a new identity), not a failure.
